query: SELECT m.slug, m.title, COUNT(cl.id) as lessonCount FROM course_modules m LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.slug, m.title ORDER BY lessonCount DESC;
